title: Noninvasive Tumor Profiling: Quantitative Contrast-Enhanced MRI Markers Predict PD-L1 and CTNNB1 Status in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
authors: Matuschewski, Nickolai J; Sobirey, Rabea; Revzin, Margarita; Zeevi, Tal; Gross, Moritz; Kasolowsky, Victor; Shewarega, Annabella; Meister, Ellen; Kao, Tabea; Tefera, Jonathan; Bousabarah, Khaled; Batra, Ramesh; Strazzabosco, Mario; Lin, MingDe; Gebauer, Bernhard; Savic, Lynn Jeanette; Duncan, James; Madoff, David C; Zhang, Xuchen; Chapiro, Julius
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用MRI影像组学与机器学习预测肝癌分子标志物状态，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Systemic molecular-targeted therapy is the standard of care for patients presenting with advanced-stage hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC); however, tumor response rates are limited, mainly owing to HCC biomolecular and pathologic heterogeneity. Therefore, novel markers for noninvasive molecular profiling are needed. PURPOSE: To determine whether advanced image analysis and machine learning on routinely acquired MRI scans can help predict HCC molecular profiles, thereby allowing biomarker-guided treatment allocations. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This single-center retrospective study included treatment-naive patients with HCC who underwent tumor resection or liver transplant between September 2006 and February 2022. Multiparametric contrast-enhanced MRI data were obtained, and quantitative and qualitative imaging markers were extracted from lesion and liver segmentations. Pathologic analysis of the resected samples was performed via immunohistochemistry to assess p53 loss of function; catenin beta 1 (CTNNB1) activation; forkhead box M1 activation; and programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1), phosphorylated AKT serine/threonine kinase, phosphorylated SMAD2/3, and sterol O-acyltransferase 1 expression. For each molecular profile outcome, a multivariable logistic regression model was built separately using quantitative imaging, qualitative imaging, or clinical data. The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) was used to evaluate model discriminatory performance, and DeLong tests were performed to compare AUCs across models trained on the different data. RESULTS: Seventy-five patients with T1-weighted, contrast-enhanced, dynamic MRI scans (mean age, 65.7 years +/- 9.43 [SD]; 60 males) were included. Receiver operating characteristic curve analysis demonstrated the good discriminatory performance of logistic regression models trained on quantitative imaging data for PD-L1, p53, and CTNNB1, with AUCs of 0.85 (95% CI: 0.74, 0.96), 0.79 (95% CI: 0.66, 0.93), and 0.7 (95% CI: 0.46, 0.93), respectively. Models trained on clinical and qualitative imaging data yielded lower AUCs across profiles, of 0.36 (95% CI: 0.2, 0.53; P < .001) and 0.41 (95% CI: 0.21, 0.62; P = .003), respectively, for p53. CONCLUSION: Quantitative MRI markers derived from whole tumor and liver volumes can potentially predict p53, PD-L1, and CTNNB1 status in HCC. (c) RSNA, 2025 Supplemental material is available for this article. See also the editorial by Cannella in this issue.
abstract_zh: 背景：系统性分子靶向治疗是晚期肝细胞癌（HCC）患者的标准治疗方案；然而，肿瘤缓解率有限，主要归因于HCC的生物分子和病理异质性。因此，需要用于无创分子分型的新型标志物。目的：确定对常规获取的MRI扫描进行高级图像分析和机器学习是否有助于预测HCC分子谱，从而实现基于生物标志物的治疗分配。材料与方法：这项单中心回顾性研究纳入了2006年9月至2022年2月期间接受肿瘤切除或肝移植的未接受治疗HCC患者。获取多参数对比增强MRI数据，并从病灶和肝脏分割中提取定量和定性影像标志物。对切除样本进行病理分析，通过免疫组织化学评估p53功能缺失；catenin beta 1（CTNNB1）激活；forkhead box M1激活；以及程序性细胞死亡配体1（PD-L1）、磷酸化AKT丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶、磷酸化SMAD2/3和甾醇O-酰基转移酶1的表达。对于每个分子谱结局，分别使用定量影像、定性影像或临床数据构建多变量逻辑回归模型。采用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估模型判别性能，并进行DeLong检验以比较基于不同数据训练的模型之间的AUC。结果：共纳入75例具有T1加权、对比增强、动态MRI扫描的患者（平均年龄，65.7岁±9.43 [SD]；60名男性）。受试者工作特征曲线分析显示，基于定量影像数据训练的逻辑回归模型对PD-L1、p53和CTNNB1具有良好的判别性能，AUC分别为0.85（95% CI: 0.74, 0.96）、0.79（95% CI: 0.66, 0.93）和0.7（95% CI: 0.46, 0.93）。基于临床和定性影像数据训练的模型在各分子谱中的AUC较低，对于p53分别为0.36（95% CI: 0.2, 0.53；P < .001）和0.41（95% CI: 0.21, 0.62；P = .003）。结论：源自整个肿瘤和肝脏体积的定量MRI标志物可能预测HCC中的p53、PD-L1和CTNNB1状态。（c）RSNA，2025年 本文提供补充材料。另见本期Cannella的社论。
